id: reading-g4-islamic-the-question-at-the-window

en: The power had gone out, so Nayla and Mama sat by the open window. Without the street lights, the sky was crowded with stars.
'They're so far away,' Nayla whispered. Then, after a while: 'Mama, where is Allah? Is Allah behind the stars?'
Mama did not laugh, and she did not hurry. 'That's a good question. Let's think about the stars first. Where are they?'
'In the sky,' said Nayla. 'And the sky is above the earth. And our house is on the earth.' Everything she named was somewhere.
'Everything we can see or imagine has a size and a place,' said Mama. 'The stars, the sky, the earth, our house. Allah created all of them, and all of their places too.'
'Our teachers teach that Allah exists without a place. Allah created places and is not in need of them. Allah is not like anything He created, so we don't try to picture Allah.'
Nayla was quiet for a long time. 'That's a big idea,' she said at last.
'It is,' Mama agreed. 'Let's write your question down and ask Ustazah Fatimah on Saturday. She can explain it better than I can.'
Just then the lights came back on, and the stars faded behind the glow. Nayla found her notebook and wrote her question carefully on a new page.
id: Listrik padam, jadi Nayla dan Mama duduk di dekat jendela yang terbuka. Tanpa lampu jalan, langit penuh bintang.
'Jauh sekali, ya,' bisik Nayla. Lalu, setelah beberapa saat: 'Ma, Allah di mana? Apakah Allah di balik bintang-bintang?'
Mama tidak tertawa, dan tidak terburu-buru. 'Pertanyaan yang bagus. Kita pikirkan bintangnya dulu. Bintang ada di mana?'
'Di langit,' kata Nayla. 'Langit ada di atas bumi. Rumah kita ada di bumi.' Semua yang ia sebutkan ada di suatu tempat.
'Semua yang bisa kita lihat atau bayangkan punya ukuran dan tempat,' kata Mama. 'Bintang, langit, bumi, rumah kita. Allah menciptakan semuanya, juga tempat-tempatnya.'

'Guru-guru kita mengajarkan bahwa Allah ada tanpa tempat. Allah menciptakan tempat dan tidak membutuhkannya. Allah tidak serupa dengan apa pun yang Dia ciptakan, jadi kita tidak mencoba membayangkan rupa Allah.'
Nayla terdiam lama. 'Itu gagasan yang besar,' katanya akhirnya.
'Betul,' kata Mama. 'Yuk tulis pertanyaanmu dan tanyakan pada Ustazah Fatimah hari Sabtu. Beliau bisa menjelaskannya lebih baik dari Mama.'
Saat itu listrik menyala lagi, dan bintang-bintang memudar di balik cahaya lampu. Nayla mengambil buku catatannya dan menulis pertanyaannya dengan rapi di halaman baru.

connection.en: The story models how a family in the Ash'ari-Maturidi tradition answers 'Where is Allah?' gently: Allah exists without a place, and questions are welcome.
connection.id: Cerita ini mencontohkan cara keluarga dalam tradisi Asy'ari-Maturidi menjawab 'Allah di mana?' dengan lembut: Allah ada tanpa tempat, dan pertanyaan itu disambut baik.

connection.en: Stars are easier to see when there is less light from street lamps.
connection.id: Bintang lebih mudah dilihat jika cahaya lampu jalan berkurang.
